components.name: Train Status Lookup
components.description: The saffron action submits a five-digit train number for running status.

components.name: Secondary Button

components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-train">Train number</label><input class="ds-input-lookup" id="ds-train" type="text" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="e.g. 12952" />

components.name: Primary Navigation Link

components.css: .ds-route-board { padding: 2px 0 0 28px; border-left: 1px solid #d8d5cc; color: #1d2935; } .ds-route-heading { margin-bottom: 18px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; color: #203b53; font: 700 21px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-route-heading span { padding: 5px 7px; border: 1px solid #bb974a; color: #755516; font: 750 10px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.07em; } .ds-route-row { position: relative; min-height: 45px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 52px 52px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: #4c5861; font: 400 12px/1.3 Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-route-row::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -22px; bottom: 22px; left: 25px; width: 2px; background: #a9b3b6; } .ds-route-row i { z-index: 1; width: 10px; height: 10px; margin-left: 21px; border: 2px solid #f3f1eb; border-radius: 50%; background: #607889; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #607889; } .ds-route-row.ds-route-end i { width: 13px; height: 13px; background: #dca733; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #9b762b; } .ds-route-row b, .ds-route-row time { color: #243c50; font: 700 11px/1 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-route-row time { font-size: 12px; } .ds-route-note { margin: 8px 0 0 58px; color: #6a747b; font: 400 11px/1.4 Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-route-row:hover { background: rgba(32,59,83,0.04); } .ds-route-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d69725; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.description: A thin-ruled selectable row that leads with the train number and route endpoints.
components.css: .ds-train-row { width: 100%; min-height: 66px; padding: 10px 4px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 82px 1fr 24px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #d8d5cc; background: transparent; color: #253746; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-train-row > b { color: #294d68; font: 700 14px/1 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-train-row span { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-train-row strong { font: 680 13px/1.3 Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-train-row small { color: #5b666e; font: 400 12px/1.3 Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-train-row i { color: #6d7981; font: normal 18px/1 Inter, sans-serif; text-align: right; transition: color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-train-row:hover { background: rgba(32,59,83,0.04); } .ds-train-row:hover i { color: #a56614; transform: translateX(2px); } .ds-train-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d69725; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
RailSync treats the timetable as an instrument for finding one service among many. A warm paper field, deep railway-blue shell, and fine rules give the interface the calm order of a printed schedule adapted for a working web app. The central route is read as a sequence of stations, codes, and times; tabular numerals make the information line up at a glance.

The selected route receives a restrained saffron highlight, while green, amber, and red are reserved for actual provider or railway status. The light and night themes keep the same hierarchy and route order across a warm paper palette and a dark blue-grey palette. Data-source labels remain close to railway results so sample information cannot be mistaken for verified live updates.
keyCharacteristics: Timetable order and thin rules carry structure.
Warm paper, railway blue, and route saffron anchor the palette.
Station codes, train numbers, and times use tabular monospaced figures.
Sample and illustrative results are labeled at the point of use.

rules.name: The Signal Means Something Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red indicate a real status or provider state; never use them as decorative accents.

rules.name: The Source Stays Visible Rule
rules.body: Keep sample, illustrative, or provider-source labeling next to the railway information it qualifies.

rules.name: The Number Alignment Rule
rules.body: Use tabular monospaced figures for train numbers, station codes, and times; preserve their alignment as the viewport narrows.

rules.name: The Flat Timetable Rule
rules.body: Keep route boards and ordinary lists flat; use tonal surfaces and rules to show structure before adding shadow.

dos: Do use the warm paper ground and deep railway-blue shell for the light theme, with the blue-grey night surfaces for dark mode.
Do use saffron to point to the selected route or the primary lookup action.
Do keep timetable values aligned in the mono stack and let thin rules establish row rhythm.
Do keep the source and sample-data qualification close to the information it describes.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and readable mobile route columns.
donts: Don't present simulated data as a verified live update or a confirmed booking result.
Don't use status colors as decoration or add glow effects to the timetable's signal marks.
Don't turn the home workspace into a generic bento-card dashboard or add decorative gradients and paper textures.
Don't use shadows or animated lift on ordinary route and list content.
